title: Scanned Symbols Under Embedding
statement: For any configuration $c$ of a machine with $k$ work tapes and any work-tape index $i$, the optional symbol under tape $i$'s head in the embedded configuration equals the optional symbol under tape $i$'s head in $c$.
hypotheses_covered: A configuration with $k$ work tapes over a symbol alphabet and state set
replaced:
For any configuration $c$ of a machine with $k$ work tapes and any of the $k$
original tape indices $i$, the symbol scanned on tape $i$ in the embedding of
$c$ into the $(k+1)$-tape oracle model equals the symbol scanned on tape $i$
in $c$.
